correctness.rationale: The lattice-difference classification is exhaustive in the only norm range that can intersect for \(r\le3/2\). The exact lens integral gives volume \(4(r-1)^3/3\); three unordered short-neighbor lenses occur per covolume-4 cell; and distinct short neighbors are separated by \(\ell_1\)-distance 4, so positive-volume triple intersections are impossible. Inclusion-exclusion therefore yields the claimed fractions exactly. Endpoint covering and density \(9/8\) are independently supplied by arXiv:2609.23210v1. The embedded checker reproduces the algebraic identities but is not used as an infinite proof.
